output.summary: Independent review 1 of 4a4aa8a..71b4533: Not ready. Behaviour unchanged (forms identical before/after for every state and viewer: actions, revision, gate, hash, required fields, confirm; server.ts and plan-store.ts untouched; approve hash = sha256 of the raw text shown). Important I1: high-risk plans draw the six-step bar on two rows because .steps{display:grid;repeat(5)} comes later than .plansteps{display:flex} with the same specificity. Important I2: docBody drops any '# ', Status:, Owner:, gate line anywhere and turns any 'N. ' line into a list item, so a Goal starting with a Korean date ('2026. 12. 1.부터') loses the year and a Domain '# …' vanishes. Minor: G3_NOTE says 위 for a fold now below; stepOf for cancelled plans ignores approvals; test gaps (stepOf failed/cancelled/splitting/open, blocked G3 refusal, failure and open questions to others, design raw-only, duplicate split fold, for/aria-describedby, phone names display:none); textarea description includes the ⓘ label; OPEN BLOCKING after an id; nested lists flattened; answer boxes labelled only 답.

evaluation.feedback: Fix I1 (.steps.plansteps flex so six steps stay on one row; a style test) and I2 (drop only the first '# ' title and Status/Owner/gate lines before the first '##'; a lone 'N.' paragraph stays a paragraph; tests for both); also the minors: G3_NOTE 아래, stepOf for cancelled uses approvals, the listed test gaps, aria-describedby on the hint text only, OPEN BLOCKING only at the line start, the answer label names its question. Re-measure rows in the browser.
